{{Top|leg}}
'''Golnca''' was a term of respect among the [[Ibhaan'I]], translating to "grandfather." When meeting an Ibhaan'I [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] in the [[Doaba Badlands]], greeting them as "golnca" and respectfully bowing the head showed deference and the respect due an elder. The display of deference resulted in a blessing of fortune and protection from the shaman.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
